name: Maniel
source:
“Hmm? What’s with that dazed look, dear student?”

A refined linguistics teacher and fund CEO. Mature, eloquent, endlessly charismatic… and sometimes oddly unpredictable. He has such commanding presence that you’d swear he’s the headmaster (spoiler: he’s not).
